NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Browser setup prompts only once
patches.description: Shows the browser accessibility and shortcut-menu-strip setup prompts once, then records each as shown as soon as it appears so closing the browser before dismissing it cannot make it repeat.

patches.name: Preset browser settings
patches.description: Sets fresh-install browser fallbacks for normal and incognito modes: Brave search, matching suggestions, and Google search by image by default. Saved or imported choices are preserved and can be changed later in 1DM.

options.title: Search engine
options.description: Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Saved or imported choices are not overwritten.

options.title: Search suggestions
options.description: Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Match uses the selected provider when 1DM supports it, otherwise None.

options.title: Search by image
options.description: Fresh-install fallback for normal and incognito browsing. Brave and DuckDuckGo are not supported by 1DM for reverse image search.

patches.name: Remove ads and promotions
patches.description: Removes visible banner/full-screen ads and 1DM+ promotions from free 1DM 20.0 (30257), including the downloads-home VPN promo bar and sponsored browser start-page tiles. User shortcuts remain available.

patches.name: Remove ads, proxy & restrictions
patches.description: Removes CashRaven background bandwidth sharing, all ads and sponsor/unlock gates, external browser redirects, the startup Telegram join dialog, promo marquee banners, forced-update lockouts, promo push notifications, and clone/sniffer checks.

targets.description: Universal APK (arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a / x86 / x86_64, Android 7.0+), build 53

options.title: Hide promo marquee ticker
options.description: Hides the scrolling announcement/redirect marquee bar on Home and Player screens.

options.title: Bypass update & force-update screen
options.description: Skips optional and forced update prompts on Splash startup.

options.title: Block promotional push notifications
options.description: Suppresses promotional/browser-redirect FCM notifications and skips the startup notification permission prompt while preserving silent RemoteConfig API updates.

options.title: Bypass clone, work-profile & sniffer checks
options.description: Allows running inside work profiles, app cloners, or alongside HTTP debugging tools.

options.title: Strip proxy & ad native libraries
options.description: Removes ~7.7 MB of unused CashRaven residential-proxy (libcr_android.so, libjnidispatch.so), Unity Coherence (libunitycoherencenative.so), legacy MIPS/armeabi folders, and WebView ad-viewer assets.
